author: yulinkservices
title: Looking for Graphic Artist (Remote, Commission-Based)
content:
📣 We’re Looking for a Graphic Artist (Remote, Commission-Based) 📣

📍What You’ll Do:
-Transform customer-provided JPEG logos or artwork into high-quality, production-ready designs quickly and efficiently, without relying on AutoTrace or equivalent programs.
-Bring creativity and precision to artwork, following specific or sometimes limited instructions based on customer expectations, needs, or art manager specifications.
-Follow detailed design guidelines and standards to ensure every piece works perfectly in production.

📍What We Are Looking For:
-Minimum of 2 years of vector design experience in Adobe Illustrator CS6 or higher, supported by a strong portfolio.
-Excellent organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. Must be able to multitask effectively in a fast-paced environment and pay close attention to detail.
-Must have a reliable internet connection suitable for remote work.
-Willingness to use time-tracking software.
-Available for the graveyard shift (11 PM to 8 AM PHT, Monday to Friday).
-Open to Filipino citizens only.

📍Additional Information:
-This is a remote, commission-based role paid per artwork.
-Earnings can reach up to ₱38,000 per month or more, depending on the number of artworks you complete. The more you finish, the more you earn.
-Paid training provided during the first 6 weeks.
-This is a performance-based role, where your earnings reflect your speed, quality, and dedication.
-There is no daily project limit, allowing you to maximize your earning potential.
-100% work-from-home setup, giving you full flexibility and comfort.

📩 Send your resume and portfolio to: yulinkhr@gmail.com
📌 Subject line: Graphic Artist – [Your Full Name]
